newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria depo rates fall due to high supply.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria depo rates fall due to high supply.

text.p: Bulgaria's interbank deposit rates fell from Monday amid a high supply of lev funds and low demand, dealers said.
"Banks have enough free levs which is the reason for the low demand and the falling rates," said a bank dealer.
Overnight depo rates fell to 1.75-2.0 percent annually from 2.0-2.4 percent on Monday. Spot week rates were around 3.5-4.0 percent annual against 4.0-4.5 percent.
The average annual interbank deposit rate was 2.24 percent on Monday against 2.13 percent on Friday, a central bank official said.
The central bank's simple annual main interest rate has been set at 6.12 percent since Monday.
